messages:
Maya: Heads-up team: were targeting TOMORROW 10:00am ET for the Redwood Optimize benchmark + blog publish. Embargo in place until 10:00am ET. Need to lock final press kit, social threads, GTM tracker links, and a clear primary contact for press replies. @Oliver @Tess please confirm your owners.

Oliver: Ill take press replies and reporter triage. Will prepare a one-pager Q&A and share contact list. Planning to reach out to top-tier folks 15m before embargo lift. Link to PR doc: https://drive.redwood/benchmark-pr-kit (will add updated media list).

Tess: Social plan ready but need final CTAs and the short-form copy approved. Two threads (tweetstorm + LinkedIn carrousel). Sample tweetstorm opener: 
"Benchmarks that matter: Redwood Optimize cuts token cost and latency at scale. Details + methods: <link>"
I'll schedule posts for 10:05am ET and have replies queued for the first hour.

Rahul: Engineering confirmed the 99.9p tail number and the quantized model variants used. Legal asked for a slight wording change to the Methods: replace "identical inputs" with "matched input distributions". I've updated the appendix draft, see the methods file in the repo.

Maya: Good. Also we need the demo GIF and hero image uploaded to CDN. @design-bot can you confirm assets exist under /assets/optimize-2025/?

support-bot: support-bot: Notifying support rotation: oncall for tomorrow 10:00-11:30 ET: @Priya. Prepopulating canned replies: https://confluence/redwood/support/canned/benchmark-launch.

design-bot: design-bot: Assets present: /assets/optimize-2025/hero.png and /assets/optimize-2025/demo.gif. CDN purge scheduled for 2025-06-16 09:40am ET.

Priya: I'll own support during launch and monitor press mentions in first 2 hours. Please add the standard escalation path for embargo breaches to the PR doc.

Maya: Quick contingency plan in case of early leak: 
```
- Pause socials (Priya)
- Notify Legal + CEO (Maya)
- Hold off on publish until PR approves updated messaging (Oliver)
- If necessary, move publish + embargo to 2pm ET and notify reporters
```

Oliver: Adding a reporter-friendly embargo note and reminder about not publishing until 10:00am ET. I'll DM any VIP contacts the embargo time.

Tess: Approved social copy from comms perspective. Small ask: can the blog include an explainer block for "what changed for dedicated customers"? I can draft.

Rahul: Sam from infra will run one final bench at 6pm PT and post bench-final.json to the repo. I'll pull numbers into the appendix.

Maya: Final checklist for tonight: Legal sign-off  Rahul (pending wording tweak) | Bench run  Sam (6pm PT) | Assets uploaded  design-bot (confirmed) | Press owner  Oliver | Support  Priya. If anyone hits a blocker by 7pm PT, flag here.

Oliver: Also prepping a brief reporter Q&A doc and a Slack channel for real-time PR replies. Channel: #press-bench-release.

Priya: Noted. I'll stand by on support and social hold/unhold.

Maya: Thanks all  see you on the 9:30am ET runbook call. If anything changes post-7pm PT I'll update this thread. :rocket:
